environment.description: Same Celery worker deployed in namespace 'batch-workers' on EKS. The namespace has a Cilium-managed NetworkPolicy with a default-deny egress posture. An additional CiliumNetworkPolicy object (name: 'worker-egress-baseline') permits egress only to the Redis broker CIDR (10.100.0.0/16 port 6379) and the internal report-storage service (10.200.5.0/24 port 443). The policy uses entity-based selectors with 'matchLabels: app=report-worker' and explicitly includes a deny rule for CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on all ports as a belt-and-suspenders measure. The node's iptables also have a PREROUTING chain rule (inserted by a DaemonSet 'imds-restrict') that drops packets from pod CIDR to 169.254.169.254, but this is secondary to the Cilium enforcement. Note: the Jinja2 SSTI itself remains exploitable for local code execution within the container - the network policy only prevents the specific credential-theft escalation path via IMDS.
